resources.title: Mamba-3: Part 1
resources.notes: **Emerging.** New this pass — the named-but-unverified "Mamba-3" item, now confirmed and fully fetched. Primary-source post by one of Mamba's co-creators explaining Mamba-3's architectural changes over Mamba-2 (exponential-trapezoidal discretization, complex-valued/RoPE-style state rotation, MIMO SSMs, BCNorm, removal of the short conv) with concrete latency benchmarks (1.5B model, H100, batch 128: Mamba-3-SISO ≈140.6s vs. Mamba-2 ≈149.0s vs. vLLM/Llama-3.2-1B ≈976.5s at 16,384 tokens) and open-sourced kernels. Underlying paper is arXiv 2603.15569 (ICLR 2026 oral), March 2026 — extremely current; not yet broadly replicated outside the authors' own lab, hence "emerging" rather than "established."

resources.title: On-Policy Distillation
resources.type: Kevin Lu et al., Thinking Machines Lab
resources.notes: **Emerging.** Fetched; new post-training method (per-token reverse-KL distillation from a fixed teacher), reports beating RL at ~10x less compute on AIME'24; independently referenced by Qwen3 report but not yet broadly replicated outside a few labs. Published Oct 2025, within window.

resources.type: Aaron Blakeman et al., NVIDIA (199 authors)
resources.notes: **Established** (within NVIDIA's own hybrid-Mamba lineage; feeds directly into the later Nemotron 3 / Nemotron 3 Ultra MoE-hybrid family). First submitted Apr 2025, revised Sept 2025 — just outside the strict 12-month window but included as directly relevant background, same treatment as DeepSeek-V3.

resources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
resources.notes: **Established** open model; the MuonClip optimizer technique (Muon + QK-Clip to control attention-logit growth, enabling a reported zero-loss-spike 15.5T-token pretraining run) is itself an emerging training technique. New this pass — the named-but-unverified "Kimi K2 technical report" item, now confirmed and fetched (abstract/summary level). 1.04T-parameter MoE, 32B activated; reports SWE-Bench Verified 65.8, AIME 2025 49.5, GPQA-Diamond 75.1 (non-thinking settings). v1 submitted Jul 2025, v2 revised Feb 2026.

resources.title: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model
